title: refactor: share CLI harness lifecycle helpers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shares model validation, home-path resolution, and restore-or-strip behavior across all five CLI harnesses.
- Preserves adapter-specific configuration, credentials, setup order, and protection for user-edited files; removes an unused OpenCode writer parameter.
- Adds 13 regression cases; all 98 CLI tests, package build, CLI help smoke test, Biome, and diff checks pass.
- Standalone TypeScript checking has the same 27 existing diagnostics as untouched main; no new diagnostics.

gist.headline: Five hives, one toolkit
gist.blurb: The CLI harnesses now share their careful housekeeping routines. Same adapter personalities, fewer copies of the broom.
gist.summary: Refactored all five Polli CLI harnesses to share model validation, home-path resolution, and restore-or-strip lifecycle helpers while preserving adapter-specific setup, credentials, and user-edited-file protection.
gist.impact: CLI users get the same harness behavior with 13 added regression cases guarding configuration restoration and cleanup across DSH, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Pi, and Prime.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a cozy workshop caretaker, using a small tool belt to connect five differently decorated CLI harness stations to one shared set of neatly labeled maintenance tools. Tiny code-plants and protected flower pots represent preserved user configuration, while a CRT robot happily verifies each station.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, organizing five small retro CLI terminal stations around one shared lime green (#ecf874) toolbox; each station has its own gentle adapter decorations while protected code-plants grow in labeled pots. A chunky CRT monitor robot checks the tidy connections beside warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach gradients, with subtle pixel text reading "SHARED HELPERS"; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
